description: List or search the IMF's datasets — CPI, WEO (World Economic Outlook), BOP (Balance of Payments), IMTS (trade in goods), GFS (government finance), MFS (monetary and financial), FSI (financial soundness), commodity prices and ~200 more. Returns the dataset id to pass to get_data and search_indicators, plus its name and description. Pass `query` to filter by name, e.g. "inflation", "trade", "government".

query.description: Optional filter matched against dataset id, name and description (e.g. "inflation", "trade").

name: get_datasets

outputSchema.description: IMF dataflow structure containing available datasets

title: Get Datasets
